item.title: Looking for R Examples to Understand Different Types of Convergence
item.description: Hello everyone, I’m studying convergence (in probability, pointwise, almost sure, and in mean) and would like an R script with a computational practice for me to study. I’m a beginner in R and haven’t been able to do anything yet. If you have a commented script, it would help a lot in my studies.
